summary.text: Yes. The Confirmation of Death is temporary. Download the digital death certificate after the doctor certifies the death online.

details.heading: The Confirmation of Death
details.body: The Confirmation of Death is only a temporary document.

steps.name: Get the details
steps.text: Find the Confirmation of Death Number, Deceased's ID Number and Date of Death on the Confirmation of Death.

steps.name: Download the certificate
steps.text: After online death certification by the doctor, download the digital death certificate at the My Legacy website.

sources.page_title: Do I need to download the digital death certificate if I have a Confirmation of Death?

quotes.text: The Confirmation of Death is only a temporary document. You should download the digital death certificate at the My Legacy website, following online death certification by the doctor.
To do so, you will need to make use of the following information from the Confirmation of Death: Confirmation of Death Number, Deceased's ID Number and Date of Death.
You should download the digital death certificate at the My Legacy website, following online death certification by the doctor.
